The `internal/scheduler` package is only referenced by its own test/example files (`example_test.go`, `integration_test.go`, `doc.go`) — nothing in `cmd/` or `server/` imports or wires it up, and no job named for database cleanup is registered anywhere in the codebase.

r03. Premise correction: there is no nightly database-cleanup job scheduled in this codebase. `internal/scheduler` (see `internal/scheduler/doc.go:1`, `internal/scheduler/scheduler.go`) is a standalone, GitHub Actions-inspired cron scheduler library, but a search of every reference to it (`internal/scheduler/example_test.go`, `internal/scheduler/integration_test.go`) shows it's only exercised in that package's own examples/tests — no `scheduler.New()`/`Register` call exists in `cmd/memos/main.go` or `server/server.go`, and there's no registered job with a cleanup/database-purge handler anywhere in the repo. The only concrete cron expression present is `"0 9 * * *"` (9 AM) used purely as a test fixture in `internal/scheduler/integration_test.go:183`, not tied to any cleanup job. So there's no actual nightly database-cleanup job with a scheduled time to report.
